purpose: Prepare a clearly marked draft service agreement for a synthetic data conversion exercise, preserving proposed terms and open negotiations.

facts.text: Proposed: This is a proposed draft only; neither party has signed or accepted it.
Definition: The fictional parties are Harbor Lantern Cooperative as requester and Maple Bridge Studio as provider.
Proposed: The proposed service is conversion of up to 40 synthetic CSV files into a documented JSON schema.
Definition: The synthetic input files contain invented inventory records and no personal data.
Proposed: The proposed provider deliverables are converted JSON files, a field mapping, and a validation report.
Proposed: The proposed requester duty is to provide the in-scope input files, up to 40, and a sample of expected mappings before work starts.
Proposed: The proposed review period is five business days after a complete delivery.
Proposed: The proposed acceptance test is that every output parses as JSON and required mapped fields match the supplied sample cases.
Proposed: The proposed provider correction window is ten business days for failures reported during review.
Proposed: The proposed fee is 2,400 fictional credits, payable only after written acceptance.
Proposed: The proposed schedule allows 20 business days after receipt of complete inputs for first delivery.
Proposed: The proposed change process requires a written scope amendment before adding files or mapping rules.
Proposed: The proposed requester retains ownership of its synthetic inputs and converted outputs.
Proposed: The proposed provider may use generated field mappings only to perform this exercise.
Proposed: The proposed provider deletes its working copies within 30 days after acceptance or termination.
The parties have not agreed on a governing law or dispute forum.
The parties have not agreed on a liability cap.
Proposed: The proposed termination rule allows either party to stop work with written notice; payment for accepted partial work remains to be negotiated.
Proposed: The proposed confidentiality obligation covers exercise inputs and deliverables, but the exact disclosure exceptions remain under negotiation.
Definition: No real payment, legal obligation, or transfer of data is authorized by this fixture.

sections.title: Draft status and scope
sections.instruction: Name fictional parties, draft status, synthetic scope, and deliverables.

sections.title: Performance and acceptance
sections.instruction: Describe duties, timing, tests, corrections, and change process as proposals.

sections.title: Commercial and data terms
sections.instruction: Set out proposed fee, ownership, permitted use, deletion, and confidentiality.

sections.title: Open terms and termination
sections.instruction: Separate unresolved law, liability, exceptions, and partial-work payment.

required_goals.statement: Preserve the exact scenario facts and their observed, proposed, assumed, or defined status.
required_goals.acceptance: Every factual assertion agrees with a relevant supplied fact; no changed actor, number, date, or status.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer compares claims with the fixed fact ledger.

required_goals.statement: Cover all required facts and section purposes.
required_goals.acceptance: Each required fact appears accurately in an appropriate section and each section fulfills its instruction.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer checks required fact IDs and section instructions against the output.

required_goals.statement: A reviewer can identify proposed obligations and open negotiating points without treating draft text as binding.
required_goals.acceptance: The document supports its stated reader decision or action within its declared scope.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer assesses the fixed purpose and audience against the output.

required_goals.statement: Do not add unsupported facts, outcomes, causal conclusions, or authority.
required_goals.acceptance: No material claim exceeds the supplied facts, including headings, lists, tables, and captions.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer audits all factual text and planted negative assertions.

required_goals.statement: Keep observed results, proposed actions, assumptions, definitions, and unknowns distinct.
required_goals.acceptance: The output never presents a proposal as enacted, an assumption as observed, or an unresolved matter as settled.
required_goals.method: Independent reviewer classifies material assertions against source status and explicit unknowns.

negative_cases.mutated_assertion: The signed agreement obliges immediate payment of 2,400 credits.
The service covers up to 400 CSV files.
Maple Bridge Studio must supply the input files.
Thirty-day deletion guarantees that no copy can survive.
The parties selected Arizona law and forum.
Both parties executed this binding agreement on 2026-03-04.

length_goal.reason: This is an invented draft for review, not a binding contract; covering proposed terms accurately matters more than a universal word minimum.
